sales_hooks: NVIDIA is the primary HBM customer — every H200/B200 qualification win at NVIDIA directly determines which memory supplier captures the margin. Ask how marketing teams communicate their NVIDIA qualification status.
GB200 NVL72 rack = 72 GPUs × 192GB HBM = 13.8TB per rack. At scale, NVIDIA's ramp drives the largest single demand surge in memory history — quantify this for your customer's CEO.
Blackwell Ultra (GB300) requires HBM4 — qualification race between SK Hynix and Micron is a live sales opportunity. Which supplier your contact company wins determines 2027 revenue.
NVIDIA Q1 FY2027 guided ~$78B revenue (reports May 20 2026) — a beat signals accelerated GPU ramp → accelerated HBM pull-through demand.

competitive_position.vs_amd: AMD MI300X competitive on price/performance for inference; NVIDIA retains software moat (CUDA ecosystem)
competitive_position.vs_intel: Intel Gaudi 3 largely irrelevant at scale; Intel focusing on custom ASICs
competitive_position.moat: CUDA ecosystem lock-in + CoWoS packaging supply lock with TSMC + fastest HBM qualification cycle

scm_engagement.scm_role: Designs the AI GPUs that are the primary compute engine in every major AI training server. NVIDIA is the central node of the entire AI supply chain: it dictates which HBM supplier qualifies, which foundry (TSMC) packages the chips, and which server OEM integrates the systems.

server_products.name: GB200 NVL72 Rack Unit
server_products.used_in: Hyperscaler AI training clusters (Microsoft, Google, Meta, Amazon)
server_products.note: 72 B200 GPUs + 36 Grace CPUs in one 19-inch rack. Requires Vertiv/Schneider liquid cooling.

server_products.name: NVSwitch 4.0
server_products.used_in: Inside DGX/HGX servers, NVL72 rack backplane
server_products.note: Connects all 72 B200 GPUs inside GB200 NVL72 at full bandwidth. TSMC N4 process.

server_products.used_in: AI server cluster networking (all NVIDIA-based AI clusters)
server_products.note: InfiniBand connects servers in a training cluster. BlueField-3 handles offloaded networking.

scm_engagement.scm_position: GPU tier — central integrator of HBM + GPU die at TSMC; sold to hyperscalers and server OEMs

lead_time.description: NVIDIA GPU ship-out → tokens served ≈ 6 months. HBM must be qualified and ready at TSMC before GPU ships; the actual GPU→server→DC pipeline runs fast because hyperscalers have pre-built infrastructure.
lead_time.bottleneck: TSMC CoWoS capacity — GPU production is gated by CoWoS slot availability, not GPU design speed
